description:
An open-source third-party launcher for all PC games of HoYoverse that aims to completely replace the official HoYoPlay launcher.

Starward is an open-source third-party launcher developed to address the shortcomings of HoYoPlay (miHoYo Launcher). It supports all PC games of HoYoverse and aims to completely replace the official launcher. In addition to the basic functions of a launcher, it includes additional features such as recording game time, switching game accounts, viewing game screenshots, and saving gacha records.
Thank you for your patience! We've made significant changes to the overall software architecture recently and fixed several legacy issues. Some breaking changes were unavoidable, so you will need to relocate your games after updating.
Highlights
- Reworked game installation: The underlying architecture has been redesigned around launcher channels. Custom channels are now supported. After updating, you will need to relocate your games.
- Updated Battle Records: Web-based login has been replaced with HoYoverse Pass login. You will need to log in again after updating.
- Added Genshin Impact cutscene resource management: You can now free up to 40+ GB of storage space by removing the associated files. See the screenshot below for the feature's location.
Other Updates
- Added support for the complete game installation workflow and fixed the pre-download process for Honkai Impact 3rd.
- Removed the setting for hard link functionality. Hard links are now enabled by default and cannot be disabled. Hard link storage usage is now displayed in installation progress and the game list.
- Removed registry-based account switching. HoYoverse Pass authorization is now used instead.
- Removed the unified game settings page. Only special graphics settings are retained in each launcher's settings page (Genshin Impact: HDR; Honkai: Star Rail: frame rate).
- Removed the option to register URL protocols from Advanced Settings. The installed version now registers them automatically.
- Removed the option to keep RPC running in the background from Advanced Settings. The RPC process now exits together with the main process.
Known Issues
- The Battle Records page for the Global server is currently unable to log in (404 error). Please wait for a future update to resolve this issue.
